name: issues-graph
description: Hosted dependency graph for GitHub Issues

scripts.validate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.social-card: pnpm dlx playwright@1.63.0 screenshot --viewport-size=1200,630 "file://$PWD/design/social-card/social-card.html" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/issues-card.png" && magick "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/issues-card.png" -strip -quality 92 -sampling-factor 4:4:4 -interlace Plane public/social-card.jpg
